svg.title: About Yamraj Khadka
svg.desc: Computer Engineer and AI/ML engineer & researcher from IOE Purwanchal Campus, based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Builds AI systems end to end, from research and fine-tuned LLMs to production pipelines. Focus: LLMs, RAG pipelines, agentic AI, computer vision, MLOps. Open to AI research, data science and ML engineering roles, and research collaborations.

g.text: I build AI systems end to end: from research and fine-tuned LLMs to production pipelines.
